input.program:
$filters = {"modes": [], "carrierIds": [], "directOnly": false}
$show = false
modeSummary = Query("local_query", {"version": 1, "sources": [{"datasetRef": "dataset-1oyk6nv", "alias": "fares"}], "where": {"all": [{"field": "originId", "op": "eq", "value": "london"}, {"field": "destinationId", "op": "eq", "value": "paris"}, {"field": "serviceDate", "op": "eq", "value": "2026-10-02"}, {"field": "mode", "op": "in", "value": $filters.modes.length > 0 ? $filters.modes : ["train", "bus", "flight", "ferry"]}]}, "groupBy": ["mode"], "metrics": [{"as": "minPriceCents", "op": "min", "field": "priceCents"}, {"as": "minDurationMinutes", "op": "min", "field": "durationMinutes"}, {"as": "count", "op": "count"}], "orderBy": [{"field": "minPriceCents", "direction": "asc"}], "limit": 4})
hero = TravelHero("artifact-4ef54d13-b74b-4e11-9694-36d8f5e06547", "dataset-1oyk6nv", null, null, "London to Paris · 2 October 2026")
modes = ModeChips("artifact-4ef54d13-b74b-4e11-9694-36d8f5e06547", null, null, null, "Transport modes", null, null, $filters, "filters")
breakdown = ModeBreakdown("artifact-4ef54d13-b74b-4e11-9694-36d8f5e06547", "dataset-1oyk6nv", null, null, "Minimum price, fastest duration and fare count", null, null, null, null, modeSummary)
comparison = Section("artifact-4ef54d13-b74b-4e11-9694-36d8f5e06547", null, null, null, "Compare modes", null, [modes, breakdown])
showDetails = RetryAction("artifact-4ef54d13-b74b-4e11-9694-36d8f5e06547", null, null, null, "Show details", null, null, null, null, null, Action([@Set($show, true)]))
coverage = CoverageSummary("artifact-4ef54d13-b74b-4e11-9694-36d8f5e06547", "dataset-1oyk6nv", null, null, "Loaded coverage")
details = Section("artifact-4ef54d13-b74b-4e11-9694-36d8f5e06547", null, null, null, "Resource details", null, [showDetails, $show ? coverage : null])
panes = SplitPane("artifact-4ef54d13-b74b-4e11-9694-36d8f5e06547", null, null, null, null, null, [comparison, details])
root = TravelSurface("artifact-4ef54d13-b74b-4e11-9694-36d8f5e06547", "dataset-1oyk6nv", null, null, "London–Paris mode comparison", null, [hero, panes])
